clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather's death in July 1989, within the year: your mother's worry over money starting in March 1988 and her move to distance from your father over money in May 1988, your grandfather's death in July 1989, your brother Felix's grades falling in November 1989, and your mother calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts in money worry and distance between your parents sit in the months before the death, and your brother's functioning falls after it, with your mother's anxiety easing as she returns to work; the period settles by spring 1990.

clusters.name: Your mother Della's diagnosis of breast cancer, 1994–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother's diagnosis in February 1995, within the preceding and following months: you left home for college in September 1993, migraines kept you in bed starting in March 1994, you called your brother most nights in April 1994, your mother was told she had breast cancer in February 1995, you stopped returning your brother's calls in June 1995, and you stopped calling home by February 1996. Your own symptom rose and your turn toward your brother came first; after your mother's diagnosis, you moved away from your brother and then away from home, a shift in how you related to them both. The period settles once the moves in your relationship are made by early 1996.
